title: OPM Biosciences Launches Integrated Cell Culture Media-to-Manufacturing Platform for Biosimilar Development
llm_note: OPM Biosciences launched a cell culture media-to-manufacturing platform specifically for biosimilar development and production.

title: Resilience Further Advances North American Manufacturing Strategy Transformation

title: Andelyn Curator Biomanufacturing Platform Supports Fayuvi Gene Therapy Approval
llm_note: Andelyn Biosciences is manufacturing the FDA-approved gene therapy Fayuvi at its Columbus, Ohio facility.

title: ACIC Equipment USA Inc. Welcomes Patrice Pelletier as President
